GitHub - Alan-Leo-Wong/GPU-SVO
This repository contains a GPU-accelerated implementation of a sparse voxel octree (SVO) based on the techniques described in the papers "Fast Parallel Surface and Solid Voxelization on GPUs" (ACM) and "Data-Parallel Octrees for Surface Reconstruction" (IEEE).
